name: Honda CB125S
engine: 122 cc air-cooled overhead-cam single, one carb, five-speed
intro: Honda's long-running small single. Simple and cheap to run, with points, a cam chain and one carb.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
